title: Detailed key
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Key bow (handle) - big ornate ring at top left -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="30" r="18" fill="#FFD54F" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="30" r="10" fill="#4DD0E1" stroke="#26C6DA" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="30" r="5" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <!-- Inner decorative spokes on bow -->
  <rect x="26.5" y="14" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#FF8F00"/>
  <rect x="26.5" y="38" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#FF8F00"/>
  <rect x="12" y="28.5" width="8" height="3" rx="1" fill="#FF8F00"/>
  <rect x="36" y="28.5" width="8" height="3" rx="1" fill="#FF8F00"/>
  <!-- Diagonal spokes -->
  <rect x="16" y="18" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#FF8F00" transform="rotate(-45 17.5 22)"/>
  <rect x="37" y="18" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#FF8F00" transform="rotate(45 38.5 22)"/>
  <rect x="16" y="34" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#FF8F00" transform="rotate(45 17.5 38)"/>
  <rect x="37" y="34" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#FF8F00" transform="rotate(-45 38.5 38)"/>

  <!-- Key shaft (stem) going down-right -->
  <rect x="40" y="44" width="10" height="46" rx="2" fill="#FFD54F" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(35 45 67)"/>

  <!-- Key teeth (bit) at the bottom end -->
  <!-- Main tooth -->
  <rect x="62" y="82" width="14" height="9" rx="2" fill="#FFD54F" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(35 69 86)"/>
  <!-- Second tooth -->
  <rect x="59" y="90" width="10" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD54F" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(35 64 93)"/>
  <!-- Notch detail between teeth -->
  <rect x="66" y="86" width="4" height="4" rx="1" fill="#4DD0E1"/>

  <!-- Shaft highlight line -->
  <rect x="43" y="47" width="2" height="38" rx="1" fill="#FFF59D" transform="rotate(35 44 66)"/>

  <!-- Bow-to-shaft connector detail -->
  <rect x="38" y="43" width="12" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFB300"/>

  <!-- Small sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="42" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="78" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="95" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
